run_training: run the learning-to-learn training loop with configurable epochs, learning rate, and problem type
create_meta_optimizer: create a MetaOptimizer instance with network configuration for meta-learning optimization
build_meta_minimize: build a meta-minimize operator that returns step, update, reset, and cost operations
run_epoch: run one optimization epoch returning elapsed time and cost using a TensorFlow session
save_meta_optimizer: save the trained meta-optimizer to a directory when evaluation cost improves
